reports.desc: I received a text message from 1-833-950-0621 from Illinoisfiling.com.  I pushed on the link and it wanted me to confirm all of my information.  Then it said pay $299.00 and I would never have to file again.  They sent it twice and asked for my banking information.  This is when I called the BBB to check to see if it was a scam.  It is a scam.

I found a cute dress on a website called KATEGRANA and was told they ship within one business day. A few business days later, I followed up by email and phone call and heard nothing. The item never shipped, and they never reached out to me. They took my money and are still claiming to sell clothing online, but it's a scam.
I won 25 sc (equivalent to $25) in a promotion but never received it. Customer service said I never participated but I have screen shots of my winning total (timed and dated by Poly Casino)

Ordered two dresses off Lilisrose.com. One dress was wrong. The other didn’t fit. The return policy on the website says full returns within 30 days and that they would provide prepaid return postage. Package was shipped from California, but now they are asking for it to be mailed to Hong Kong and for me to pay the shipping and that they will supposedly reimburse me for the shipping afterwards. I’ve pushed back on this asking for the prepaid postage, and contacted my credit card company.

Fax of an invoice received on 10/20/2026 from Webenvy360 for $498.65. Invoice states it is for monthly digital marketing services "under the agreed scope of work". We do not use Webenvy and have never heard of them until this fax arrived. I researched and found this scam has been going on for several years.

Ordered a mini Christmas Advent Calendar which appeared to be assorted plastic blocks which would be assembled each day of advent and hung on the Christmas tree.
items  received were flat plastic Christmas shapes contains various Christmas scenes.  No information available to return item for a refund.
Attached is the email. SnattleGrass is a CAA colleague. The scammer posed as me and asked her to pay a vendor $1500.00.
Ordered their product online and they charged me more than I anticipated and then I checked out there site on ****** they have way more complaints I’ve ever seen.

Since October 2025, I have received over 600 unsolicited prerecorded calls promoting supposed personal loans/debt relief. I have NEVER applied for a loan, answered these calls, returned a call, or consented to these solicitations. This caller identified themself as "business verification department" and claimed there was an "urgent issue with your business listing" on Google. I don't have a business listing on google. Other recordings use similar fictitious personal stories and loan approvals. I have preserved numerous voicemails, screenshots, dates, caller-ID numbers and callback numbers and have reported this to the FTC numerous times. This appears to be a large-scale, persistent robocall campaign, not isolated calls.
Scam Caraway cookware website declined purchase but stole credit card info. They added my info to their phone “Wallet” then used to purchase merchandise.

This website uses poor quality materials and doesn’t list the materials on the website. Additionally the colors are not as advertised. They issue  satisfaction guarantee but do not accept returns due to it being a “custom” order. Once you order you cannot leave a review and if you try to leave one in incognito mode it does not allow you to. Poor quality, unwearable item, misleading reviews.

I ordered pollinator cups for my landscaping from an ad that was listed on a ad that was on instagram It described the pollinator cups were made by a pottery artist in Connecticut. I ordered them thinking they are coming from Connecticut. I received an email and shipping information that said they are being sent from China. I received them but they were not anything like what was shown in the ad. I tried to find my order and email and it was no longer accessible. This was 08/18/25/2026,when ordered and then another charge for $29.95 was pending on my credit card as of 9/11/2026. Then on 10/18/2026 they charged my card again one for $14.98 & $14.97. I contacted EM-Evelmont through email and told them I did not sign up for no membership and I wanted a refund for the $29.95.  Have not received the refund for the $29.95 ,

Fake online store at nruwellness.shop impersonating the retailer NRU and the diaper brand Tykables. The site uses NRU's logo (loaded from nru.co.uk) and lists support@nru.com as its contact. It sells Tykables-branded products using the brand owner's product photos and product descriptions copied word for word, without permission, at a fake 65% discount (for example $9.26 marked down to $3.24). Other pages are generic fashion-store template text (testimonials about a "blazer," a "contemporary fashion destination" About page) that do not match the products sold. The domain was registered on 2026-09-18 with a privacy-redacted registrant and is hosted on a server registered in China. The checkout uses Stripe. This looks like a fake store set up to take payments for goods that will not ship. Buyers should avoid it. The real brands' official sites are tykables.com and nru.co.uk.

On Sept. 16, 2026 I purchased quilted bags from Easylifexo and paid for them with a Visa credit card. The only communication I received at that time was they got paid. In two weeks I wrote Easylifexo where was my product and in their reply was a tracking link. I have since been checking the tracking and it looks like it was in Marion, Illinois for several days and then the link said it was delivered Oct. 18, 2026 but it was not. I have contacted Easylifexo and their response was to check my delivery notification which I never got and to check with my family and neighbors to see if it was delivered to another home. My address is very clear on my receipt and we get correct deliveries all the time. I have asked for proof of delivery and will be asking my credit card company for a refund.
